scripts.kill-ports: sh -c 'for p in 48310 48311; do pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:$p); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "Killing :$p ($pids)"; kill $pids 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done'
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.deploy: npm run kill-ports && npm run migrate -w server && npm test -w server && npm test -w client && npm run build -w client
